Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in Conroe, Texas, at a two-lane road with a slight curve. It was a low-speed collision, maybe ten or fifteen
miles an hour when we met.
Q: Where were you traveling, and what was the other vehicle doing?
A: I was heading in my lane and the other car drifted over the center line. We ended up nose to nose. Neither of us
was going fast, but the impact was enough to set off the airbags on my side.
Q: Did you have any warning before impact?
A: I hit the brakes as hard as I could, but there wasn't time to avoid it. I felt a jolt and my right hand slammed into the
steering wheel.
Q: Did you seek medical attention afterward?
A: Yes, I was taken to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They X-rayed my wrist and told me it was fractured.
I've been in a cast since then.
Q: Are you still under treatment?
A: I have a follow-up appointment next week with an orthopedic spceialist to check the healing and decide whether I
need physical therapy.
Q: Has anything else about the accident been btohering you, such as neck or back pain?
A: My neck is a little sore, but nothing serious. Mostly it's the wrist that's keeping me from work and daily tasks.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add before we conclude?
A: No, I think I've covered it. I just want to get my car repaired and get my wrist healed.
Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
</page>
